name: The City in Carbon Paper
prompt: Lay a sequence of nested cobalt printing sheets across an open yard, corners turned up by wooden windlasses. Walkers leave white silhouette trails through the blue. Printers peel off yesterday's layer like the skin of an enormous fruit.

name: The Printer's Tidal Pool
prompt: Float islands of carved black type in a shallow cinnabar ink basin. Printers in pale aprons steer them into patterns with long poles. A hinged paper sail lowered over one side carries away a print of the entire assembly.

name: An Edition in Clay
prompt: Arrange rows of unglazed terracotta cylinders on parallel axles in an open court. People press letters into the soft clay. One fired cylinder rolls over wet paper under a wooden arch, leaving a continuous russet impression.

name: The Paper Lung
prompt: Build two immense ivory concertina bellows lying side by side, one open and one compressed. The closing folds press hand-cut illustrations onto sheets fed by a chain of neighbours. Finished sheets emerge on a snaking red drying rail.

name: The Night Type Garden
prompt: Raise mirrored type blocks on thin black stems among pools of violet ink. At dusk printers tilt each block to catch a beam of light and expose its shape onto photosensitive pages spread out like flower beds below.
